title: Quiz — 11.1 & 11.2 Measures of Center, Variation, and Box-and-Whisker Plots

questions.prompt: Which measure of center is most affected by an outlier?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The mean is most affected because it includes every value in the calculation.

questions.prompt: The median of the data set 3, 5, 1, 5, 1, 1, 2, 3, 15 is ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The ordered list is 1,1,1,2,3,3,5,5,15; the median is 3.

questions.prompt: What is the range of the data set 19, 20, 21, 22, 22, 24, 25, 25, 27, 27, 32, 48?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The range is 48 − 19 = 29.

questions.prompt: In the standard deviation formula, what is the mean of the squared deviations called?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It is called the variance.

questions.prompt: If every value in a data set is multiplied by 5, what happens to the standard deviation?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The standard deviation is also multiplied by 5.

questions.prompt: If 10 is added to every value in a data set, the range ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The range stays the same because both the maximum and minimum increase by 10.

questions.prompt: Which measure of center can be used for non‑numerical data?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The mode can be used for non‑numerical data, such as favorite color.

questions.prompt: A data set has a mean of 30. Each value is increased by 7. What is the new mean?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The new mean is 37.

questions.prompt: A small standard deviation indicates that the data values are:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A small standard deviation means the data are clustered around the mean.

questions.prompt: The mode of the data set 5, 3, 5, 1, 5, 1, 2, 3, 15 is ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: 5 appears three times; the mode is 5.

questions.prompt: What is the five‑number summary of a data set?
options: Mean, median, mode, range, standard deviation
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The five‑number summary is minimum, Q1, median, Q3, maximum.

questions.prompt: In a box-and-whisker plot, the box is drawn from Q1 to Q3, and the line inside the box represents the ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The line inside the box is the median.

questions.prompt: For the backpacker ages 18, 22, 22, 24, 25, 25, 25, 27, 28, 30, 30, 30, what is Q1?
What is the interquartile range (IQR) of a data set with Q1=10 and Q3=18?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: IQR = 8.

questions.prompt: What percentage of the data lies in the box of a box-and-whisker plot?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The box contains the middle 50% of the data.

questions.prompt: If the left whisker is longer than the right whisker, the distribution is skewed ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Skewed left.

questions.prompt: A box-and-whisker plot of song lengths has min=160, Q1=220, median=250, Q3=280, max=300. What is the range?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Range = 140 seconds.

questions.prompt: In a double box-and-whisker plot, which measure indicates which data set has a higher typical value?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The median indicates the typical value.

questions.prompt: Entrée prices have Q1=10.5 and Q3=14.75. The IQR is ___ dollars.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: IQR = 4.25 dollars.

questions.prompt: What is the first step in making a box-and-whisker plot?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: First, order the data from least to greatest.
